w_now_d: Power at the input right now, with voltage and frequency.
w_inputLimit_d: How much of the input's limit is used, per phase, and what no point measures.
w_today_d: Energy and money today and this month, the tariff zone in force.
w_insights_d: Where money goes: standby load, peaks, what the solar saved.
w_phases_d: Load, current and voltage on each phase.
w_flow_d: Where the power comes from and where it goes.
w_hours_d: Energy or money by hour, today against yesterday.
w_tiles_d: A tile for each metered line.
w_tile_d: A single point's tile, wherever you want it.
w_alarms_d: Points offline, over their rating or with a warning.
w_tariff_d: The day's tariff zones and the one in force.
w_kpi_d: Input now, taken and given today, cost, autonomy.
w_pointsTable_d: Every point with power and today's energy.
w_evNow_d: How many stations charge, and the car park against the input limit.
w_evStations_d: A card for each charging station.
w_evPower_d: Today's car-park power against the limit.
resetBody: Your blocks, boards and their order are replaced by the standard view for this hub.
editHint: Drag a block by its handle or use the arrows; change its size, settings or remove it. «Done» saves the view.
emptyBoardView: This board is empty. Open «View → Customise» to add blocks.
emptyBoard: No blocks on this board yet.
whereHub: The view is saved on the hub: every phone and computer shows it.
whereBrowser: The view is saved in this browser.
tooBig: This view is too large to save. Remove a few blocks or boards.
localOnly: My own view on this device
dragHint: Drag to move; arrow keys move it too
s_flowHome: Diagram (with the phase and scene views)
hint: You can arrange the Overview yourself: «Customise» moves and resizes blocks, adds or removes them, orders and hides point tiles, makes your own boards.
whereDevice: This view is kept on this device only; the hub's view stays as it is.
saveNeedsToken: Saving the view on the hub needs the admin token. Enter it in Settings → Security, or tick «My own view on this device».
conflictTitle: The view was changed on another device
conflictBody: Someone saved the Overview on another phone or computer while you were arranging it. Keep yours (it replaces theirs) or take the one on the hub (yours is dropped)?
w_setup_d: What isn't set up on the hub yet — each step leads to its place.
hintShort: You can arrange the Overview yourself.
emptyNow: Nothing to show right now — the block stays out of sight on the Overview until there is.
